question: 8月华东区的妥投率是多少？
A_sql: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN s.status = 'delivered' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS delivery_rate FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON s.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.region = '华东'   AND strftime(o.order_time, '%m') = '08'
B_sql: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN s.delivery_time IS NOT NULL THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS delivery_rate FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id = o.order_id WHERE c.region = '华东'   AND o.order_time >= TIMESTAMP '2024-08-01 00:00:00'   AND o.order_time < TIMESTAMP '2024-09-01 00:00:00'
C_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.delivery_time IS NOT NULL) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON s.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.region = '华东' AND s.ship_time >= DATE '2024-08-01' AND s.ship_time < DATE '2024-09-01'
